ref.locator: famiwal.be 'Résumé des montants' (Dernière modification: 10/09/2026), section 'Allocations familiales de base', table 'Enfants nés à partir du 1er janvier 2020', row '0-17 ans'; same figure on 'Vos allocations familiales de base' (Dernière modification: 08/09/2026)
ref.quote: Enfants nés à partir du 1er janvier 2020 | Enfant | € | 0-17 ans | 200,51 € | De 18 à 24 ans | 213,44 €
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Re-downloaded both FAMIWAL pages on 2026-10-20: 200,51 € (0-17, born from 1 Jan 2020) and 213,44 € (18-24) found verbatim; Résumé page last modified 10/09/2026, base page 08/09/2026. Arithmetic 200.51 × 12 = 2,406.12 checks. Value confirmed; label corrected because 'one (Walloon) child' overstates the scope: children born before 2020 stay on the old rank-based scale (123,94 / 229,32 / 342,39 €), and the amount excludes the age, social, single-parent, orphan and disability supplements that the same budget line pays. All children born from 2020 are under 18 in 2026, so the 0-17 rate applies to every one of them. 'Waals kind' replaced by 'kind in Wallonië' (entitlement follows residence, not nationality). The page does not state since when 200,51 € applies; it is +2% on the earlier 196,57 € (consistent with a September 2026 indexation), so a year at this rate is the rate in force in autumn 2026, not the 2026 calendar-year average. FAMIWAL is a public fund; amounts are set by Walloon law and identical at all funds. The dotation line (AVIQ family branch) does pay this benefit. Researcher's working: 200.51 €/month × 12 = 2,406.12 €/year Monthly amount as displayed on 2026-10-20 (page 'Dernière modification: 10/09/2026'); the page does not state from which month it applies, so it reflects the indexation in force in autumn 2026 (earlier in 2026 the amount was lower). Basic amount only: excludes the yearly age supplement (prime scolaire), social supplements, orphan and disability supplements, which the budget line also pays. Children born before 2020 stay in the old system (rank-based: 123.94 / 229.32 / 342.39 €/month for 1st / 2nd / 3rd+ child per the same table), and 18-24-year-olds get 213.44 €/month, so this is not the average cost per child. FAMIWAL is one of the payment funds; the amounts are set by Walloon law and are the same at every fund.

ref.quote: Prime de naissance ou d'adoption/enfant | Allocations familiales de base | Supplément d'âge annuel | A côté des montants de base, vous êtes susceptibles de recevoir un ou des suppléments suivant votre situation et/ou vos revenus. | Vous pouvez prétendre à un supplément social si vos revenus ne dépassent pas ou sont égaux [...]
ref.note: Entitlement line: the amounts are set by the decree of 8 February 2018 on the management and payment of family benefits ('Décret du 08 février 2018 relatif à la gestion et au paiement des prestations familiales', cited as legal basis in wal-aju-2026-ep-sante, DF 093.023, PDF p. 80) and its implementing orders, and are indexed. The appropriation follows those rules and AViQ's estimates ('Ce crédit est destiné à couvrir la charge des allocations familiales réajusté en fonction des derniers facteurs d'actualisations calculés par l'AVIQ', same page); none of the four phrases can happen through the appropriation alone, only through a change to the decree or its orders, and how any change would be split across the parts is a political choice. The four phrases name the four parts listed on the Famiwal page: basic monthly allowance, social supplement (the 'supplément social' for incomes under a ceiling), annual age supplement ('prime scolaire') and birth/adoption grant. Other supplements (single-parent and large families, orphans, children with a disability or illness, long-term illness of the parent) exist on the same page. Allowances are paid by Famiwal and by private funds under the same rules; the private funds' fees (DF 093.024) and Famiwal's operating grant (DF 093.008) sit in the health/social line. corrected: source and quote confirmed on famiwal.be (last modified 10/09/2026) and the appropriation text in wal-aju-2026-ep-sante p. 80. Point 4: kept all four parts (each is a distinct, sourced part of the benefit) but reworded neutrally as the amount of each part ('a lower monthly family allowance' etc.), dropped the redundant 'per child', used 'family allowance' in EN to match the line label, used Famiwal's term 'supplément social' in FR/EN and dropped 'modestes'; caveat now names the decree with its full title and page and states plainly that none of the changes follows from the appropriation alone.
